summary: @servicetitan/carto-charts-rn ships preinstall alternate-runtime dropper that executes an obfuscated Bun payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (string-array rotation, _0x-mangled identifiers) and, on npm install, downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into an OS tempdir, extracts it (unzip / PowerShell Expand-Archive / a hand-rolled ZIP parser), chmods it executable, and invokes it against the bundled ~727KB math_init.js payload shipped in the package. math_init.js is a Bun-compiled bundle (header '// @bun @bun-cjs') further obfuscated with a string-array shuffle (WV8StW rotates a ~2000-entry constants array); its capabilities cannot be read without deobfuscation. The package presents itself as a React Native chart library (a single Chart component), a purpose that does not require pulling a second language runtime at install time or executing an opaque 700KB Bun binary. The alternate-runtime delivery routes execution around Node-focused install-time inspection so the true payload runs under a runtime the ecosystem's scanners do not analyze. This is the alternate-runtime dropper shape: the runtime source (bun.sh / oven-sh releases) is only the delivery vehicle; the executed code is the obfuscated math_init.js the package ships.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
